scope: Byte-identity baseline replay plus signed, near-linear BBN sensitivity to exact weak-rate input perturbations.

file_reference.path_rule: nonempty safe POSIX path relative to the contract directory; no symlinks
file_reference.hash_rule: lowercase SHA-256 of exact file bytes

baseline_identity.rate_input: baseline replay bytes must equal production BBN input bytes
baseline_identity.output: baseline replay bytes must equal production BBN output bytes

derivation.inside_window: multiply only the named rate field by 1+perturbation_fraction

interpretation_limit: Passing establishes that the declared BBN execution responds to the supplied weak-rate histories. It does not validate the nuclear reaction network or its rates.
